The '''Leresen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Lannik Wilds]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Leresai]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SotP" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Leresen system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square R-13.<ref name="TEA" />
